summary: XMax Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary, Xmax Beta Holdings Ltd., entered into a Subscription Agreement with Preamble X Capital I, increasing its interest in that fund to over 99.9% via a $8.77 million additional subscription. No specific price per share, premium, or other deal terms were disclosed. The subsidiary completed the subscription on July 7, 2026. The filing is a routine internal capital restructuring within a fund structure, not a transformative special situation such as an acquisition or divestiture.
